results.title: Opinion: What are billionaires so afraid of? A 5% tax, apparently
results.description: California’s proposed 5% one-time billionaire wealth tax has drawn tens of millions in opposition from wealthy residents, despite supporters’ claims it would fund healthcare.

results.title: Industrial equipment exec drops $71M on Naples estate in off-market deal
results.description: A new mansion in Naples sold for $71 million in an off-market deal, marking one of the most significant sales in the city this year. Douglas Schumann, founder and CEO of Connecticut-based industrial equipment supplier P-Q Controls, paid $1.6 million for furnishings and $69.4 million for the 9,550-square-foot property at 2050 Gordon Drive. The deal worked out to $7,435 per square foot. Property records show the seller was a trust associated with Scott Gibbs Clawson, chairman and CEO of water systems treatment company Culligan International. Paul Arpin, Pete Reppucci and Michael Giacalone of Premier Sotheby’s International Realty handled the transaction. […] This article originally appeared on The Real Deal. results.title: Dream Resorts appoints Nikki Golden as Director of Experience
results.description: Dream Resorts, the hospitality company behind Maui Resort Rentals and Beachview Rentals, has announced the appointment of Nikki Golden as Director of Experience. In her new role, Golden will oversee Guest and Owner Experience while helping establish a unified service model and experience standards across the growing Dream Resorts portfolio.

results.title: Hawke's Bay council records biggest capital programme
results.description: Only NZD $347,000 was left for unexpected costs after Hawke's Bay Regional Council spent a record NZD $75.1 million on capital projects.
